synthetic_disclaimer: Predefined operational simulation scenarios for university demonstration.

scenarios.name: Twin Cities Morning Baseline
scenarios.description: Standard morning conditions across Islamabad and Rawalpindi with all primary corridors open and moderate waiting queues.

scenarios.name: Faizabad Gateway Disruption (Replan Test)
scenarios.description: The central Faizabad junction link is blocked due to emergency maintenance. Forces teams crossing between Islamabad and Rawalpindi to replan routes via I-8 or Expressway.

scenarios.name: High Urgency Skill Shortage (CSP Infeasibility Demo)
scenarios.description: Multiple simultaneous critical wildlife and water rescue calls. Designed to stress-test CSP constraint solver and prove transparent candidate rejection reasons.

scenarios.name: Monsoon Flash Rainstorm Congestion
scenarios.description: Severe weather congestion on Srinagar Highway and Blue Area corridors (2.5x travel time). Demonstrates how UCS and A* dynamically adapt to congested edge weights.
